name: Docmode Health Technologies Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2017, Docmode Health Technologies Ltd is in the business of
 offering integrated learning solutions 
through online and offline learning 
models for healthcare professionals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
DocMode is a healthcare technology company providing integrated learning solutions, cutting-edge practice tools, and comprehensive research platforms. DocMode's comprehensive product suite includes the DocMode LERN platform, which provides an online learning environment with resources and networking for 3.50 Lac+ healtcare professionals. Under this platform, company offers certification programs, national and international speaker programs, live inter active case-based quiz programs, and the Gapsule platform to bridge knowledge 
gaps between the pharmaceutical industry, medical practitioners, and healthcare providers
